scope: Candidate-file reconciliation, not per-control completion. Source triage covers every candidate; backlog explicitly requires deeper template/style/runtime review. Evidence lines are in 06-control-inventory.json. Changes to the scanner now include navigation, fields, counts and remaining shared widget names.
owner: The next contributor changing each surface, with a maintainer-selected reviewer. No unassigned backlog is an approved exception.

entries.nextStep: Lazy external player entry uses Button for explicit provider activation and native original links. Preserve per-provider consent, independent alternatives, local-only recognition, and bounded failure fallback.

External player uses Button for load and close, labelled cross-origin iframes and visible error text. Preserve narrow viewport sizing, no autoplay on initial load, content-warning boundaries in callers, and teardown of widget listeners. Persistent Radio widgets remain visible in the dock.

One Forum discussion: a link-weight MbButton back to the list (its query restored) and a Notice when the root could not be reached, around the unchanged thread page. Preserve the ThreadPreload hand-off (no refetch when the scan holds the whole tree) and the thread page as the only renderer.

Dialog, Field/Control (list select and new-list name) and MbButton add the people of a discussion to a list. Preserve the up-front follow check (Mastodon lists hold only followed accounts), status and alert text, batch-then-single fallback, and the omission of other servers' accounts.

Forum's right rail: a Rail Card of compact two-line people rows. The avatar is a native profile link; the name, Badge roles and counts sit in one native row button (aria-pressed) that toggles the People facet, deliberately not an MbButton pill because these rows are data, not actions. The shared FollowButton (webfinger for other servers) and MbButton Follow everyone / Add everyone to a list (bulk-actions dialog and progress) remain the actions. Preserve 14px row insets, counts before the truncating handle, the in-discussion and most-active modes, and me excluded from group actions.

Forum's discussion list: Page Header with a help link, Field/Control for the source picker, MbButton for Scan, the Recent/Popular toggle (aria-pressed), Stop and Scan deeper, Badge for question and partial markers in each card's footer, and Content State for empty and Mastodon-only states. Roots reuse StatusCard; each footer's stats line is the native link into the discussion. One persistent sr-only status announces scan start and end, never the call counter. Preserve the 16px inset, Stop keeping found results, stable row order with an explicit re-sort, and the ceiling on Scan deeper choices.

The Studio catalogue uses Button for scanning, refreshing, cancelling and previews, and Content State for failures. Preserve bounded catalogue scrolling, account-isolated scan checkpoints, cached reloads and distinct missing-post handling.

Radio uses icon ToolbarButtons with accessible names for transport, fullscreen and provider actions, Button for reveal and provider consent, and Field/Control for native seek and volume ranges. While an external player is not ready, an overlay makes the controls inert and offers the single consent or load step. Preserve player-scoped shortcuts, native range keyboard behavior, explicit content-warning reveal, bounded queue scrolling, and fullscreen Zen cleanup without stopping session playback.

The persistent Radio dock is a sticky in-flow bar in the centre column. It uses icon ToolbarButtons with accessible names for pause/play, next, frame folding and stop; Button for provider consent and loading; and a native router link to the full player. Preserve mobile navigation clearance, the loaded-but-folded provider frame, content-warning privacy and the shared session across route changes.

Playlist uses Navigation/NavLink tabs to separate Search, Publish, Saved and My Playlists, with compact ToolbarButtons for search queue actions. Radio discovery uses Field/Control, Button and Content State; audio results reuse StatusCard and its content-warning boundary. Playlist actions use Button with a post-menu overflow; rows use icon ToolbarButtons with accessible names, including Rename (AppDialogs prompt). Thread publication uses Field/Control for visibility, Button for publish/update/find/adopt, and status/alert text for plans, progress and failures. Preserve explicit source selection, labelled controls, scan progress, cancellation, retained results on failure, bounded pagination and visible publication cost.

Field, Control, MbButton and Content State build the watch-party finder; tag suggestions are native links and results reuse StatusCard. Preserve tags in the URL, quiet skipping of invalid tags with an alert only for typed input, Open party links built from validated Watch params, and the plain note when Watch cannot play a post.

Field, Control, MbButton and Content State build the video search; fediverse results reuse StatusCard and YouTube results reuse the video player controls. Preserve q in the URL, discarding answers to superseded searches, the Plus gate on YouTube, the noopener Google hand-off and the rail/results grid on the header tracks.

One MbButton toggle with aria-pressed and a video-specific label adds to or removes from the watch queue, disabled when the queue is full. Preserve the per-video label and the absence of the control when a source cannot be replayed from Watch.

Page Header, Content State and MbButton cover the queue page; rows are a native ordered list. Preserve play order, disabled Move up/down at the ends, confirmation before Clear, Watch links built only from validated Watch params and the untitled fallback.

Popover and MenuItem own the mode menu surface, rows, dismissal and above/below placement. The trigger remains a native button styled as a primary-nav tab peer. Preserve the light-dismiss toggle guard, focus return to the trigger, link rows to each mode landing route, the current-mode marker and the flag-off rollback to the original shell nav.

Text-only profile editing uses Dialog, Field/Control and Button with the Bookmarks tab style for Edit and Preview. Slideshow playback, speed, fullscreen, history and content-warning actions use MbButton. Preserve keyboard access, bounded presentation layout, chronological playback, readable overflow and explicit sensitive-content reveal.
